title: Self-complementary completions on six vertices
summary: Let \(\cthreshold(n)\) be the largest integer \(q\) such that every loopless digraph on \(n\) vertices with at most \(q\) arcs is isomorphic to a spanning subdigraph of a self-complementary digraph of order \(n\). We prove that \(\cthreshold(6)=7\). The upper bound is witnessed by \[ \bK{3}\dunion (x\longrightarrow y\longrightarrow z), \] and follows from a direct argument with a self-complementing permutation.
